basis.method: Manifest observation (persist-migration-observations) + eslint-scope free-global dry run of every classic source + owner decision framework

tierRule: A: per-frame / hot loop, owns gameplay state, save format or timing; B: stateful orchestration without per-frame work; C: stateless adapters, data, leaves.
orderRule: Provider before consumer (an ESM target never reads a classic global); the compat runtime tag precedes only slots >= 30 until it moves before slot 1 (M1 step 2); M2 clusters are provisional and are re-reviewed (version 2) when M1 is released.
